description.zh: 根据『谁比谁高 / 跑得快 / 年纪大』的线索，把所有小朋友排成完整顺序。训练的是传递性比较推理：从一条线索排两人，到连接两三条线索排出三四人的关系链。角色都是小朋友，不用动物或物体，避免孩子凭常识（猎豹比马快）而不看线索就答对。
description.en: Build a complete ordering of the children from clues like 'who is taller / faster / older than whom'. This trains transitive comparison reasoning: from ordering two children using one clue to linking two or three clues into a chain of three or four. The characters are always children, never animals or objects, so the answer cannot come from world knowledge (a cheetah is faster than a horse) without reading the clues.

designModel.zh: 主轴是线索数（一条 → 两条 → 三条）配合关系理解形式（同词 → 反义词 → 最…→ 第几）。每一级都要求动手排出完整顺序；G2 的三条线索顺序被打乱，孩子必须自己把它们连成链，而不是按出现顺序读下去。
designModel.en: The primary axis is clue count (one, two, three) paired with relation form (same word, opposite word, most/least, n-th). Every level requires building the complete order. At G2 the three clues are shuffled, so the child has to link them into a chain rather than read them in the order they appear.

ageRange.noteZh: K1 从 4 岁起：即使是一条线索，也需要听懂『比』字句；K1-K2 可以依赖语音朗读。
ageRange.noteEn: K1 starts at 4: even a single clue requires understanding a comparative sentence; K1-K2 can rely on the spoken prompt.

seriesBoundary.policyZh: 本模块属小精灵系列。与 learning/math/logic 共用 RG.LOGIC.REASONING.BASIC，但 logic 讲解推理方法；本模块只做大量快速的比较链练习。中英文版本的角色名各自取本语言的常用名（小明、小红 / Tom、Amy），不是互相翻译。
seriesBoundary.policyEn: This module belongs to MindSeeds. It shares RG.LOGIC.REASONING.BASIC with learning/math/logic, but logic teaches reasoning methods; this module is high-volume, fast comparison-chain practice. The Chinese and English versions each use common native names (小明, 小红 / Tom, Amy) rather than translating one another.

geneReporting.ruleZh: 每次 Attempt 上报 RG.LOGIC.REASONING.BASIC，不随等级变化。
geneReporting.ruleEn: Every attempt reports RG.LOGIC.REASONING.BASIC, regardless of grade.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: 一条线索比两人；两条连三人；三条连四人。线索永远是相邻两人的比较，所以链条总能唯一确定顺序。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: One clue compares two children; two clues link three; three clues link four. Clues always compare neighbours in the order, so the chain always fixes a unique order.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: same-word 线索说『高』，问『谁更高』；opposite-word 线索说『高』，问『谁更矮』；extreme 问最高或最矮；rank 问第二或第三（从高数或从矮数）。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: same-word: the clue says taller and the question asks who is taller; opposite-word: the clue says taller and the question asks who is shorter; extreme asks for the tallest or shortest; rank asks for second or third (counted from either end).

difficultyAxes.noteZh: chained 线索按链条顺序出现（A>B，B>C）；shuffled 顺序被打乱，且保证不会碰巧仍是链条顺序。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: chained presents clues in chain order (A>B, then B>C); shuffled mixes them up and guarantees they do not happen to stay in chain order.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: 排序板包含题目里出现的所有小朋友，所以人数等于可排序卡片数；保留原有 answer、options 和 optionTypes 作为诊断元数据。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: The ordering board contains every child in the item, so the number of people equals the number of movable cards. The existing answer, options, and optionTypes fields remain as diagnostic metadata.

sessionPolicy.noteZh: 一次 5 题，通过线 75%（4/5）。推理题读题较慢，所以比其他规律猎手少 1 题。没有静态题库：generator.js 现生成，玩完立即换一批。
sessionPolicy.noteEn: Five items per run, passing at 75% (4/5) — one fewer than the other pattern hunters because reasoning items take longer to read. No static bank: generator.js builds each set and a new one is swapped in when the run ends.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 读一条同词关系线索，把两个小朋友排成完整顺序。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Read one same-word relation clue and put both children into the complete order.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 理解『A 比 B 高』的相反方向，再把两个小朋友排成完整顺序。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Interpret the reverse direction of a clue such as 'A is taller than B', then put both children into the complete order.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 把两条线索连起来，在排序板上排出三个人的完整顺序。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Link two clues and build the complete order of three children on the board.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 连接三条被打乱的线索，在排序板上排出四个人的完整顺序。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Link three shuffled clues and build the complete order of four children on the board.

statistics.noteZh: 保留 optionTypes 中 wrong_end、adjacent_rank 和 middle_item 作为原有诊断答案元数据；实际交互记录完整排序的结果等级、重试次数和提示次数。
statistics.noteEn: The existing wrong_end, adjacent_rank, and middle_item optionTypes remain as diagnostic answer metadata. The interaction reports the full-order result tier, retries, and hints.
